user_history.review_text:
This is a pretty nice period kit, but it doesn't include everything I need, and it has things I will never use. I wish there were options for the tampons that come in the box. For example, I need mostly light tampons, some regulars, and a few supers, as well as some overnight pads (it is a really bad idea to sleep with a tampon in). This box came with only regular tampons. The other items that came were a handful of liners, scented feminine wipes, one pain killer (acetaminophen), a serum face mask, an eye mask, 4 bags of raspberry leaf tea, 2 Ferrero Rochers, and a wafer chocolate called a "knopper".

Over all, it's a well curated box, but it doesn't replace me having to go to the store to get tampons and pads. There are also things that I would never use, such as the scented feminine wipes (a bad idea for any person with a vagina), tea in a tea bag, and the pain killer that could interfere with my medications. Some people may be able to use this box, but I think it is not for me. I would rather make my own kit that has things I will actually use.

Note, this box does take over 2 weeks to arrive.
user_history.review_title: As advertised, but not for me

features: Top rated organic period box curated by fellow menstruators

2 organic comfort items and 2 organic snacks
Over $80 in value each month
Give as a gift - Treat a menstruator to some period self-care

user_history.review_text:
I am only giving this box 5 stars because it deserves way more than 1.6 stars, and I want to counter balance the negative reviews.

If I had continued getting similar to what I got in my first box, I would have continued this subscription. The first box seemed like a perfect emergency period kit. It had a few regular pads and tampons (not enough for a full period, but enough to get by until you can get to the store), a couple of overnight pads and super tampons, a handful of pantyliners, a couple of patches for period cramps, and wipes for bloodstains (love those). The next box had different cramp patches and no bloodstain wipes. Instead, there were snacks in this box (banana chips, granola bites, and chocolate)
Overall, I like the other various items I got in the box, especially the CBD massage oil that was in every box (It's amazing!). It seems like everything together is worth about $45 to $55, so it's not getting a deal, and is actually rather pricey considering I got the pampered ($80).
I'm not sure if I like or dislike that there is the same fabric zip pouch in every box. On one hand, it is a really useful bag, on the other hand, if I was to keep this subscription box for a year, I would have 12 bags. I have uses for all three I have gotten, but I'm going to run out of uses eventually. It would be helpful if the bags were different in every box. The bags being the same makes it hard to tell them apart and harder to find things.

I liked getting a few of these boxes, but I just can't justify keeping this subscription. If there were enough products for a full period, a comprehensive period emergency kit, a different bag every month, and the extra items in every box, I could see keeping it. As is, it just isn't worth it every month. That said, it is a nice treat once in a while.
user_history.review_title: Nice to get one or two, but not a long term subscription.
